pages.text: Hammerheads no longer drop beef — a fact that should trouble you retroactively. $(item)Raw Shark Meat$() smokes into steaks or simmers into $(l:orespawn_delight:the_kitchen/the_cooking_pot)Shark Fin Soup$().

Whales yield great slabs of $(item)Whale Blubber$(). Render it into $(item)Whale Steak$() over any fire, or melt it down with milk and potato for a $(l:orespawn_delight:the_kitchen/the_cooking_pot)Whale Chowder$() worth the harpooning.

Flounder and skate give up delicate $(item)Flounder Fillets$() — the base of Butter-Seared Flounder, Buttered Skate Wing, and the Flounder Roll. A knife in hand when the fish dies means the occasional extra fillet.
